title: English, B.A. (Behrend)
notes: Pattern B (genuinely different program from University Park's English, B.A.) -- confirmed by directly comparing this Behrend bulletin page against Backend/degree_plans/ENGL-2026.json (the UP plan, College of Liberal Arts, 'Traditions of Innovation' option). The two share almost nothing: UP's common requirements are ENGL 200/201 + ENGL 487W/494H + 18cr Supporting + a 12cr 'Traditions of Innovation' option built from four literary-era groupings; Behrend's are a completely different course list -- ENGL 200 + ENGL 312 (Globality and Literature, not offered as a UP requirement at all) + ENGL 482W (not ENGL 487W) + a Shakespeare requirement (ENGL 443/444) + a Senior Thesis/Internship (ENGL 494/495) + a Language/Linguistics elective (APLNG 210/ENGL 100/LING 100) + 18cr of Supporting coursework split into named categories (Professional Writing, American Literature, Gender and Sexuality Studies, Racial and Ethnic Diversity, CMLIT/ENGL 200-level-or-below) that don't correspond to UP's era groupings at all. Real credit math confirmed against the bulletin: Prescribed (9cr: ENGL 200/312/482W) + Shakespeare (3cr) + Thesis/Internship (3cr, using the 3cr floor of the bulletin's 3-6cr range) + Language/Linguistics elective (3cr) + Supporting (18cr: 6+6+3+3cr across the five named categories) = 39cr, matching the bulletin's stated 39-42cr major-credit range at its floor. The five Supporting categories and the Language/Linguistics elective are adviser-driven pools without a bulletin-enumerated course list (same genuine-open-pool situation as UP English's era groupings), so they are modeled as unenforced generic slots, same convention used there. BA Degree Requirements (24cr: World Language proficiency through Level 3 = 12cr, 3 BA Knowledge Domain courses = 9cr, World Cultures = 3cr) and General Education (45cr, modeled as GQ/GWS/GHW/Inter-Domain/generic GenEd slots -- not sub-divided into every individual PSU GenEd knowledge-domain bucket, an approximation noted here honestly) round out the plan to this file's ~122.5cr total, inside the bulletin's own stated 121-124cr range. First-year seminar uses PSU 7 (First-Year Seminar Behrend, real course, added to Backend/catalogs/psu_catalog.json this session) rather than UP's LA 83, since LA 83 is a College of Liberal Arts (UP-only) course. Codes not already present in Backend/catalogs/engl_catalog.json (ENGL 200/312/443/444/482W/494/495/100, all pre-existing) needed no new catalog entries.
